name: ElegantFin TV
description: Minimal ElegantFin design with native Jellyfin motion and Media Bar focus support. Requires a compatible File Transformation plugin. LG C4 integration still requires on-device verification.

versions.changelog: Hide Media Bar and seasonal particles in mobile layout and remove reserved home-row spacing. Restrict the updated seasonal script to desktop effects without mobile CSS or item-metadata requests. Keep profile image actions in normal flow without a shadow covering the username. Browser extensions are separate release assets.

overview: ElegantFin for webOS and TV layouts
